title: DeepSeek：DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 1017
content:
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 is the October 17, 2026 snapshot of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, served by DeepSeek under the deepseek-flash API model name. V4.1 Flash is a sparse mixture-of-experts model from DeepSeek, and the first built on the company's Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) architecture. It activates 8B parameters on input and 16B on output from a 552B-parameter backbone, an asymmetric split that keeps per-token compute low relative to the model's total size. Image understanding is native to the architecture, with visual and text embeddings trained jointly from the start of pre-training rather than added afterward as in the earlier experimental V4 Flash Vision ExpOpens in new tab.
It is suited for coding, terminal, and computer-use agents, along with long-horizon tasks that must run to completion across many steps and long-context analysis. Compressed KV caching cuts cache memory to roughly a quarter of the previous Flash generation, significantly reducing costs on agentic workloads. DeepSeek positions it as the cost-efficient tier of the V4.1 family and reports that it exceeds V4 ProOpens in new tab on performance, speed, and task completion time.
Different companies host the same model. OpenRouter routes your request to one of them based on the routing mode you pick — Balanced (price + speed), Nitro (fastest), or Floor (cheapest).

Performance
Throughput is how fast the model writes (tokens per second — higher is better). Latency is total round-trip time (lower is better). TTFT is time-to-first-token — how long before you see anything appear (lower is better).
Uptime
Uptime is the percentage of the past 3 days that at least one provider was responding to requests. Availability is the percentage of time that inference was successfully served. OpenRouter continuously monitors and uses the next-best provider when one returns an error.
Benchmarks
Scores on standardized evaluations and this model’s own outputs on shared benchmark prompts. Higher percentages are better — and each rank shows where this model lands among the models evaluated on that source.

Frequently asked questions
What is DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017?
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 is the October 17, 2026 snapshot of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, served by DeepSeek under the deepseek-flash API model name. V4.1 Flash is a sparse mixture-of-experts model from DeepSeek, and the first built on the company's Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) architecture.
Where is the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 documentation?
The DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 documentation on OpenRouter includes the Does DeepSeek V4 Have Vision? blog post. The quickstart covers API keys and your first request, and the API reference lists every parameter.
How much does DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 cost?
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 costs $0.09/M input tokens and $0.55/M output tokens, with separate rates for Cache Read at $0.008/M tokens.
What is the context length of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017?
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 has a 1,048,576 token context window. It supports up to 1,048,576 completion tokens.
Does DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 support tool calling and structured outputs?
Yes. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 accepts tools and tool_choice for function calling on 5 of the 6 providers serving it, and requests that send tools are routed to those providers. It also supports structured outputs via a JSON schema in response_format.
What inputs and outputs does DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 support?
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 accepts text and images as input and returns text.
Which providers serve DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017?
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 is served by 6 providers on OpenRouter: Morph, inference.net, Cloudflare, DeepInfra, DeepSeek, and Parasail. Requests are routed to the best available provider, with automatic failover to the others, and you can pin or exclude providers with provider routing.
When was DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 released?
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 was released on October 17, 2026.

report.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 上线：CED 架构、百万上下文、极低价格
report.background: DeepSeek 一直以 MoE 稀疏架构和极致性价比著称，Flash 系列是其主打走量的低价档位。V4.1 Flash 是首个基于自研 Causal Encoder-Decoder（CED）架构的模型，采用 552B 总参数、输入激活 8B、输出激活 16B 的非对称稀疏方案；多模态不再是后期加装的实验特性（早前 V4 Flash Vision 属于 Exp 试验版），视觉与文本从预训练起就联合训练。10 月 17 日快照以 deepseek-flash 为 API 名在 OpenRouter 上线，由 DeepSeek、DeepInfra、Cloudflare、Parasail 等 6 家供应商共同托管，定位为 V4.1 家族中便宜的一档，官方称其在性能、速度与任务完成时间上均超过 V4 Pro。
key_points: 552B 总参数却只激活 8B（输入）/16B（输出），这种不对称稀疏让每个 token 的算力开销远低于模型体量，是低价的核心原因。
CED 架构首次投入实际使用，编码器-解码器因果结构天然支持多模态，图像理解从预训练第一天就与文本一起训练，而不是事后补充的能力模块。
压缩 KV 缓存把缓存显存压到上一代 Flash 的约四分之一，长程 agent 反复推理的账单明显下降，官方称其在性能、速度、完成时间上超过 V4 Pro。
上下文达 1,048,576 token，支持工具调用（6 家供应商中 5 家）和 JSON Schema 结构化输出，输入文本+图像、输出文本。
价格 $0.09/$0.55 每百万 token、缓存读仅 $0.008；OpenRouter 提供 Balanced/Nitro/Floor 三档路由和自动故障转移，3 天可用性 99.90%，不走路由仅 94.83%。
report.impact: 对行业：把原本属于前沿模型的能力进一步推向低价，竞争焦点从“单次推理便宜”转向“长流程 agent 总成本低”。对开发者：百万上下文加极低缓存读价格，使跑几十步的编码、终端、电脑操作 agent 在经济上可行，且 OpenAI 兼容接口几乎零迁移成本，但需警惕快照版本带来的行为漂移和多供应商输出不一致。对普通用户：更多免费或低价产品能提供“能看图、能自己把活干完”的助手，同时单次回答背后的模型可能随时切换。
report.tools: 想上手可关注：OpenRouter（统一入口，可对比各家价格、延迟与可用性并做故障转移）、DeepSeek 官方 API 与文档、Anthropic 的 Claude Code（编码 agent 参考形态）、Nous Research 的 Hermes Agent（持久记忆+40 余内置工具），以及 DeepInfra、Cloudflare、Parasail 等托管商做成本压测。
